function pbtaBand(total,m){if(total>=n(state.adapter.advancedMin)&&m.advanced)return{label:state.adapter.advancedLabel,text:m.advanced};if(total>=n(state.adapter.highMin))return{label:state.adapter.hitLabel,text:m.onHit};if(total<=n(state.adapter.lowMax))return{label:state.adapter.missLabel,text:m.onMiss};return{label:state.adapter.mixedLabel,text:m.onMixed}}
function doPbtaRoll(){
  const idx=Math.max(0,n(state.roll.moveIndex)-1),m=state.moves[idx];if(!m){$("rollResult").textContent="Choose an existing move number.";return}
  if(state.adapter.resolution==="noDice"){$("rollResult").textContent=m.name.toUpperCase()+"\nTrigger / procedure:\n"+m.trigger+"\n\nThis game configuration does not assume a 2d6 roll. Follow the exact move text and record the changed fiction.";return}
  const stat=n(state.stats.find(s=>s.name.toLowerCase()===String(m.stat).toLowerCase())?.value),dice=[rollDie(6),rollDie(6)],total=dice[0]+dice[1]+stat+n(state.roll.modifier)+n(state.roll.forward)+n(state.roll.ongoing),band=pbtaBand(total,m);
  if(total<=n(state.adapter.lowMax)&&state.adapter.xpOnMiss)state.xp.current++;
  $("rollResult").textContent=m.name+"\nTrigger check: "+m.trigger+"\n\n2d6: "+dice.join(" + ")+" + stat "+stat+" + modifiers "+(n(state.roll.modifier)+n(state.roll.forward)+n(state.roll.ongoing))+" = "+total+"\n"+String(band.label).toUpperCase()+"\n"+band.text+"\n\nMake every listed choice and consequence true in the fiction, then ask what happens next.";
  state.roll.forward=0;render();scheduleSave()
}

  else if(a==="addPbtaRelationship")add("relationships",{name:"",type:"Bond",value:0,text:""});else if(a==="addPbtaAdvancement")add("advancements",{name:"",taken:false,notes:""});
  else if(a==="pbtaRoll")doPbtaRoll();else if(a==="pbtaAsk")$("rollResult").textContent="TRIGGER CHECK\n• What did the character actually do or say in the fiction?\n• Is the move's complete trigger met—not just its name?\n• Is the action possible with the established position, tools, access, and leverage?\n• Does the move roll, ask questions, make choices, spend a resource, or happen automatically?\nIf no move triggers, continue the conversation or use the exact game's facilitator rules.";
}

function progressUnit(){return({milestones:'milestone','character-points':'point','narrative-levels':'session','pf2e-xp':'XP','pbta-xp':'XP','swade-advances':'Advance','bitd-xp':'XP','dnd-xp':'XP'})[CFG.progression]||'point'}

function history(type,amount,memo,extra={}){const e={at:now(),type,amount,memo:memo||'',...extra};if(type==='currency')auto().currency.history.unshift(e);else auto().progression.history.unshift(e);return e}

function totalLevel(){try{return typeof window.totalLevel==='function'?window.totalLevel():stateRef().classes?.reduce((n,c)=>n+number(c.level),0)||0}catch(_){return stateRef().classes?.reduce((n,c)=>n+number(c.level),0)||0}}
function swadeRank(n){return n>=16?'Legendary':n>=12?'Heroic':n>=8?'Veteran':n>=4?'Seasoned':'Novice'}
function fateResources(){return number(stateRef().skills?.find(x=>x.name==='Resources')?.rating)}
function cocCredit(){return number(stateRef().skills?.find(x=>x.name==='Credit Rating')?.value)}
function cocBand(v){return v<=0?'Penniless':v<=9?'Poor':v<=49?'Average':v<=89?'Wealthy':v<=98?'Rich':'Super rich'}
function bitdTrackInfo(){const s=stateRef(),t=$('hyperProgressTarget')?.value||'playbook',threshold=t==='playbook'?8:t==='crew'?10:6,current=t==='crew'?number(s.crew?.crewXp):number(s.xp?.[t]);return{t,threshold,current}}
function progressionInfo(){const s=stateRef(),a=auto();switch(CFG.progression){case'dnd-xp':{const l=Math.max(1,totalLevel()),xp=number(s.profile?.xp),next=l>=20?null:DND_XP[l];return{current:xp,next:next===null?'Maximum level':Math.max(0,next-xp)+' XP',status:next!==null&&xp>=next?'Level ready':'Level '+l,prompt:next===null?'Level 20 reached.':`Standard threshold for level ${l+1}: ${next.toLocaleString()} cumulative XP.`}}case'pf2e-xp':{const xp=number(a.progression.xp);return{current:xp+' XP',next:Math.max(0,1000-xp)+' XP',status:xp>=1000?'Level ready':'Level '+number(s.profile?.level),prompt:'Pathfinder uses 1,000 XP per level; excess XP carries over.'}}case'pbta-xp':{const cur=number(s.xp?.current),max=Math.max(1,number(s.xp?.max)||5);return{current:`${cur}/${max}`,next:Math.max(0,max-cur)+' marks',status:cur>=max?'Advance ready':'Tracking',prompt:'The exact playbook defines what an advance can buy. The sheet never invents a universal PbtA level system.'}}case'swade-advances':{const n=Math.max(number(a.progression.advances),s.advances?.length||0),rank=swadeRank(n),next=n<4?4:n<8?8:n<12?12:n<16?16:null;return{current:n+' Advances',next:next?`${next-n} to ${swadeRank(next)}`:'Legendary',status:rank,prompt:'Each recorded Advance automatically recalculates Rank and opens the improvement checklist.'}}case'bitd-xp':{const x=bitdTrackInfo();return{current:`${x.current}/${x.threshold}`,next:Math.max(0,x.threshold-x.current)+' XP',status:x.current>=x.threshold?'Advance ready':x.t,prompt:'Playbook fills at 8; Insight, Prowess, and Resolve at 6; crew XP fills at 10.'}}case'narrative-levels':{const lvl=number(s.profile?.level)||1,ss=number(a.progression.sessionsSinceLevel),target=Math.max(1,number(a.progression.sessionsPerLevel)||3);return{current:`Level ${lvl}`,next:lvl>=10?'Maximum level':`${Math.max(0,target-ss)} session(s)`,status:ss>=target&&lvl<10?'Milestone suggested':`Tier ${lvl===1?1:lvl<=4?2:lvl<=7?3:4}`,prompt:'The party levels together when the Guide declares a narrative milestone, commonly around every three sessions.'}}case'character-points':{const earned=number(a.progression.earned),spent=number(s.computed?.outputs?.gurpsSpent),budget=number(s.budget);const available=budget+earned-spent;return{current:`${available} available`,next:`${earned} earned`,status:available<0?'Overspent':'Balanced',prompt:`Starting budget ${budget}; earned ${earned}; calculated spent ${spent}; available ${available}.`}}case'development':{const checked=(s.skills||[]).filter(x=>x.checked&&x.name!=='Cthulhu Mythos');return{current:checked.length+' checked',next:checked.length?'Development phase':'Use skills',status:cocBand(cocCredit()),prompt:`Credit Rating ${cocCredit()} is ${cocBand(cocCredit())}. Checked skills are resolved with externally supplied d100 and d10 results.`}}case'milestones':{const m=a.progression.milestones,total=number(m.minor)+number(m.significant)+number(m.major);return{current:total+' awarded',next:'Story-driven',status:`Resources ${fateResources()}`,prompt:'Minor, significant, and major milestones change the character according to the fiction; Fate Core does not use XP levels.'}}default:return{current:'—',next:'—',status:'Ready',prompt:''}}
}

function recordProgress(){const a=auto(),s=stateRef(),amount=Math.max(0,number($('hyperProgressAmount')?.value||1)),memo=$('hyperProgressMemo')?.value||'';if(CFG.progression==='development'){openModal('Call of Cthulhu Development if(CFG.progression==='narrative-levels'){a.progression.sessionsSinceLevel=number(a.progression.sessionsSinceLevel)+amount;history('progression',amount,memo,{target:'sessions'})}else function applyProgression(){const a=auto(),s=stateRef();if(CFG.progression==='dnd-xp'){$('levelUpBtn')?.click();closeModal();return}if(CFG.progression==='pf2e-xp'){if(number(a.progression.xp)<1000||number(s.profile.level)>=20)return;const old=number(s.profile.level);a.progression.xp-=1000;s.profile.level=old+1;history('progression',1,`Advanced to level ${s.profile.level}`,{target:'level'});if(s.hp){const gain=number(s.hp.classPerLevel)+number(s.attributes?.con);s.hp.current=number(s.hp.current)+Math.max(1,gain)}a.progression.lastPopupKey=''}else if(CFG.progression==='pbta-xp'){const max=Math.max(1,number(s.xp.max)||5);if(number(s.xp.current)<max)return;s.xp.current-=max;s.advancements=s.advancements||[];s.advancements.push({name:'Choose exact-game advancement',notes:'XP track completed '+new Date().toLocaleDateString()});history('progression',1,'XP track converted to an advancement',{target:'advance'});a.progression.lastPopupKey=''}else if(CFG.progression==='bitd-xp'){const x=bitdTrackInfo();if(x.current<x.threshold)return;if(x.t==='crew')s.crew.crewXp-=x.threshold;else s.xp[x.t]-=x.threshold;history('progression',1,`${x.t} track converted to an advance`,{target:x.t});a.progression.lastPopupKey=''}else if(CFG.progression==='narrative-levels'){const lvl=number(s.profile.level);if(lvl>=10)return;const next=lvl+1;s.profile.level=next;s.thresholds.majorMod=number(s.thresholds.majorMod)+1;s.thresholds.severeMod=number(s.thresholds.severeMod)+1;if([2,5,8].includes(next)){s.resources.proficiency=number(s.resources.proficiency)+1;s.experiences=s.experiences||[];s.experiences.push({name:'New Tier Experience',value:2})}a.progression.sessionsSinceLevel=0;history('progression',1,`Advanced to Daggerheart level ${next}`,{target:'level'});a.progression.lastPopupKey=''}else if(CFG.progression==='development'){const skillName=$('cocDevelopmentSkill')?.value,skill=(s.skills||[]).find(x=>x.name===skillName);if(!skill)return;const roll=clamp(number($('cocImproveRoll')?.value),1,100),gain=clamp(number($('cocImproveGain')?.value),1,10),old=number(skill.value),success=roll>old;if(success)skill.value=clamp(old+gain,0,99);skill.checked=false;history('progression',success?gain:0,`${skill.name}: d100 ${roll} vs ${old}${success?`, +${gain}`:', no increase'}`,{target:skill.name,roll,gain,success});a.progression.lastPopupKey=''}else if(CFG.progression==='milestones'){history('progression',0,'Milestone checklist acknowledged',{target:$('hyperProgressTarget')?.value||'minor'})}else if(CFG.progression==='character-points'){history('progression',0,'Character point spending checklist reviewed',{target:'character-points'})}closeModal();rerender();checkProgression(false)}
function checkProgression(force=false){const s=stateRef(),a=auto();if(!$('hyperProgressModal'))return;if(CFG.progression==='dnd-xp'){const l=Math.max(1,totalLevel()),next=l>=20?Infinity:DND_XP[l];if(number(s.profile?.xp)>=next)openModal(`Level ${l+1} Ready`,advancementChecklist(),`dnd-${l+1}-${number(s.profile.xp)}`,force)}else if(CFG.progression==='pf2e-xp'&&number(a.progression.xp)>=1000&&number(s.profile.level)<20)openModal(`Pathfinder Level ${number(s.profile.level)+1} Ready`,advancementChecklist(),`pf-${number(s.profile.level)+1}-${Math.floor(number(a.progression.xp)/1000)}`,force);else if(CFG.progression==='pbta-xp'&&number(s.xp.current)>=Math.max(1,number(s.xp.max)))openModal('PbtA Advancement Ready',advancementChecklist(),`pbta-${number(s.xp.current)}-${number(s.xp.max)}`,force);else if(CFG.progression==='bitd-xp'){const x=bitdTrackInfo();if(x.current>=x.threshold)openModal(`${x.t[0].toUpperCase()+x.t.slice(1)} Advance Ready`,advancementChecklist(),`bitd-${x.t}-${x.current}`,force)}else if(CFG.progression==='narrative-levels'&&number(a.progression.sessionsSinceLevel)>=Math.max(1,number(a.progression.sessionsPerLevel))&&number(s.profile.level)<10)openModal(`Daggerheart Level ${number(s.profile.level)+1} Suggested`,advancementChecklist(),`dh-${number(s.profile.level)+1}-${number(a.progression.sessionsSinceLevel)}`,force);else if(CFG.progression==='development'&&(s.skills||[]).some(x=>x.checked&&x.name!=='Cthulhu Mythos')&&force)openModal('Development Phase Ready',advancementChecklist(),`coc-${(s.skills||[]).filter(x=>x.checked).length}`,force)}
function wallet(){const a=auto(),s=stateRef(),w=a.currency.wallet;if(CFG.currency==='dnd-coins')return s.coins||(s.coins={cp:0,sp:0,ep:0,gp:0,pp:0});if(CFG.currency==='bitd-coin')return{get coin(){return number(s.resources.coin)},set coin(v){s.resources.coin=v},get stash(){return number(s.resources.stash)},set stash(v){s.resources.stash=v},get crewCoin(){return number(s.crew.coin)},set crewCoin(v){s.crew.coin=v}};return w}
function ratios(){switch(CFG.currency){case'dnd-coins':return{cp:1,sp:10,ep:50,gp:100,pp:1000};case'pf2e-coins':return{cp:1,sp:10,gp:100,pp:1000};case'daggerheart-gold':return{coin:1,handful:10,bag:100,chest:1000};default:return null}}
function currencyUnit(){return $('hyperCurrencyUnit')?.value||auto().currency.unit||({'dnd-coins':'cp','pf2e-coins':'cp','daggerheart-gold':'coin','bitd-coin':'coin','coc-finance':'cash','fate-abstract':'story funds'})[CFG.currency]||'unit'}
function currencyTotal(){const w=wallet(),r=ratios();if(r){const total=Object.entries(r).reduce((n,[k,m])=>n+number(w[k])*m,0);if(CFG.currency==='dnd-coins')return`${total.toLocaleString()} cp equivalent · ${(total/100).toFixed(2)} gp`;if(CFG.currency==='pf2e-coins')return`${total.toLocaleString()} cp equivalent · ${(total/100).toFixed(2)} gp`;return`${total.toLocaleString()} coins · ${(total/10).toFixed(1)} handfuls · ${(total/100).toFixed(2)} bags · ${(total/1000).toFixed(3)} chests`}if(CFG.currency==='bitd-coin')return`${number(w.coin)} carried coin · ${number(w.stash)} stash · ${number(w.crewCoin)} crew coin`;if(CFG.currency==='coc-finance')return`Cash ${number(w.cash).toLocaleString()} · Assets ${number(w.assets).toLocaleString()} · Spending ${number(w.spending).toLocaleString()} · Credit ${cocCredit()} (${cocBand(cocCredit())})`;if(CFG.currency==='fate-abstract')return`Resources ${fateResources()} · ${number(w.balance).toLocaleString()} ${currencyUnit()} (optional exact funds)`;return`${number(w.balance).toLocaleString()} ${currencyUnit()}`}
function syncCurrencyInputs(){const w=wallet();qa('[data-currency-key]').forEach(el=>{const k=el.dataset.currencyKey;el.value=number(w[k])});if($('hyperCurrencyUnit'))$('hyperCurrencyUnit').value=auto().currency.unit}
function currencyTransaction(sign){const w=wallet(),key=$('hyperCurrencyDenom').value,amount=Math.max(0,number($('hyperCurrencyAmount').value)),delta=sign*amount,memo=$('hyperCurrencyMemo').value;if(sign<0&&number(w[key])<amount){openModal('Insufficient Currency',`<p>The ${html(key)} balance is ${number(w[key])}; this transaction needs ${amount}.</p>`,'',true);return}w[key]=number(w[key])+delta;history('currency',delta,memo,{denomination:key});schedule();renderCurrency();renderLedgers();runAudit()}
function normalizeCurrency(){const w=wallet(),r=ratios();if(!r){if(CFG.currency==='bitd-coin'){openModal('Blades Coin & Stash',`<ul><li>Deposit: 1 coin becomes 1 stash.</li><li>Withdrawal: spend 2 stash to gain 1 coin.</li><li>Carried coin above 4 normally consumes load or must be stored.</li></ul>`,'',true)}return}let total=Math.round(Object.entries(r).reduce((n,[k,m])=>n+number(w[k])*m,0));Object.entries(r).sort((a,b)=>b[1]-a[1]).forEach(([k,m])=>{w[k]=Math.floor(total/m);total%=m});history('currency',0,'Normalized denominations',{denomination:'all'});schedule();renderCurrency();renderLedgers();runAudit()}
function renderCurrency(){if(!$('hyperCurrencyTotal'))return;syncCurrencyInputs();$('hyperCurrencyTotal').textContent=currencyTotal()}
function renderLedgers(){const a=auto(),render=(id,rows)=>{const el=$(id);if(!el)return;el.innerHTML=rows.length?rows.slice(0,80).map(e=>`<div class="hyper-ledger-entry"><span>${new Date(e.at).toLocaleString()}</span><span>${html(e.memo||e.target||e.type)}</span><b>${number(e.amount)>=0?'+':''}${number(e.amount)}${e.denomination?' '+html(e.denomination):''}</b></div>`).join(''):'<div class="hyper-note">No entries yet.</div>'};render('hyperCurrencyLedger',a.currency.history);render('hyperProgressLedger',a.progression.history)}
function runAudit(){const s=stateRef(),a=auto(),items=[];const good=t=>items.push({kind:'good',text:t}),warn=t=>items.push({kind:'warn',text:t});switch(CFG.id){case'fate-core':{const refresh=number(s.computed?.outputs?.fateRefresh),fp=number(s.fatePoints);refresh<1?warn('Refresh is below the normal minimum of 1.'):good(`Refresh ${refresh}; Fate points ${fp}.`);s.computed?.pyramidValid?good('Skill pyramid/column validation passes.'):warn('Skill pyramid/column validation needs attention.');break}case'gurps-4e':{const spent=number(s.computed?.outputs?.gurpsSpent),available=number(s.budget)+number(a.progression.earned)-spent;available<0?warn(`Point budget overspent by ${Math.abs(available)}.`):good(`${available} character points available.`);number(s.combat?.hpCurrent)<=number(s.computed?.outputs?.gurpsHP)/3&&warn('Current HP is at or below one-third; apply injury and movement rules.');break}case'coc-7e':{good(`Credit Rating ${cocCredit()}: ${cocBand(cocCredit())}.`);const checked=(s.skills||[]).filter(x=>x.checked&&x.name!=='Cthulhu Mythos').length;checked?warn(`${checked} skill improvement check(s) are ready.`):good('No unresolved skill improvement checks.');number(s.resources?.sanCurrent)<number(s.resources?.sanLossStart)-Math.floor(number(s.resources?.sanLossStart)/5)&&warn('Session SAN loss may have reached the indefinite-insanity threshold.');break}case'daggerheart':{const r=s.resources||{};number(r.hope)>number(r.hopeMax)?warn('Hope exceeds maximum.'):good(`Hope ${number(r.hope)}/${number(r.hopeMax)}.`);number(r.hpMarked)>number(r.hpMax)&&warn('Marked HP exceeds available HP slots.');number(r.stressMarked)>number(r.stressMax)&&warn('Marked Stress exceeds available Stress slots.');number(wallet().chest)>1&&warn('More than one chest is marked as carried.');break}case'pathfinder-2e-remastered':{number(a.progression.xp)>=1000?warn('At least one level is ready to apply.'):good(`${number(a.progression.xp)} / 1000 XP.`);number(s.dying)>=4?warn('Dying value is at the normal death threshold.'):good(`Dying ${number(s.dying)}, Wounded ${number(s.wounded)}, Doomed ${number(s.doomed)}.`);break}case'pbta-adapter':{const max=Math.max(1,number(s.xp?.max));number(s.xp?.current)>=max?warn('XP track is full.'):good(`XP ${number(s.xp?.current)}/${max}.`);number(s.harm?.current)>=number(s.harm?.max)&&warn('Harm/condition track is full.');break}case'swade':{const n=Math.max(number(a.progression.advances),s.advances?.length||0),rank=swadeRank(n);s.profile.rank!==rank?warn(`Rank should be ${rank} from ${n} Advances.`):good(`${n} Advances: ${rank}.`);number(s.resources?.wounds)>=3&&warn('Three Wounds marked; check Incapacitation procedure.');break}case'blades-in-the-dark':{number(s.resources?.coin)>4?warn('More than 4 coin carried; excess normally costs load or needs storage.'):good(`${number(s.resources?.coin)} carried coin.`);number(s.resources?.stress)>=number(s.resources?.stressMax)&&warn('Stress track is full; resolve trauma.');['playbook','insight','prowess','resolve'].forEach(k=>{const max=k==='playbook'?8:6;if(number(s.xp?.[k])>=max)warn(`${k} XP track is full.`)});number(s.crew?.crewXp)>=10&&warn('Crew XP track is full.');break}case'dnd-5e-5.5e':{const l=Math.max(1,totalLevel()),xp=number(s.profile?.xp),next=l>=20?Infinity:DND_XP[l];xp>=next&&warn(`Enough XP for level ${l+1}.`);good(`Level ${l}; proficiency bonus ${2+Math.floor(Math.max(0,l-1)/4)}.`);const coins=s.coins||{},cp=number(coins.cp)+10*number(coins.sp)+50*number(coins.ep)+100*number(coins.gp)+1000*number(coins.pp);good(`${(cp/100).toFixed(2)} gp equivalent.`);break}}
 a.audit.lastRun=now();const ul=$('hyperMathAudit');if(ul)ul.innerHTML=items.map(x=>`<li class="${x.kind}">${html(x.text)}</li>`).join('');return items}
function renderProgress(){if(!$('hyperProgressCurrent'))return;const i=progressionInfo();$('hyperProgressCurrent').textContent=i.current;$('hyperProgressNext').textContent=i.next;$('hyperProgressStatus').textContent=i.status;$('hyperProgressPrompt').textContent=i.prompt;if(CFG.progression==='development'){const sel=$('cocDevelopmentSkill'),current=sel?.value;sel.innerHTML=(stateRef().skills||[]).filter(x=>x.checked&&x.name!=='Cthulhu Mythos').map(x=>`<option value="${html(x.name)}">${html(x.name)} (${number(x.value)}%)</option>`).join('')||'<option value="">No checked skills</option>';if(current&&qa('option',sel).some(o=>o.value===current))sel.value=current}if(CFG.progression==='narrative-levels'){$('hyperProgressAmount').value=Math.max(1,number($('hyperProgressAmount').value)||1)}runAudit()}
function renderPortal(){const el=$('hyperPortalContract');if(!el)return;const snap=portalSnapshot(false);el.textContent=JSON.stringify({schema:snap.schema,system:snap.system,character:snap.character,derived:snap.derived,roll_contract:snap.roll_contract},null,2)}
function updateAll(){try{auto();applyFrames();syncFrameEditor();renderProgress();renderCurrency();renderLedgers();renderPortal();checkProgression(false)}catch(e){console.error('Hyper sheet update:',e)}}
function bindAutomation(){qa('[data-currency-key]').forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('change',e=>{const w=wallet(),k=e.target.dataset.currencyKey;w[k]=number(e.target.value);schedule();renderCurrency();runAudit()}));$('hyperCurrencyUnit')?.addEventListener('change',e=>{auto().currency.unit=e.target.value||'unit';schedule();renderCurrency()});$('hyperCurrencyAdd').addEventListener('click',()=>currencyTransaction(1));$('hyperCurrencySpend').addEventListener('click',()=>currencyTransaction(-1));$('hyperCurrencyNormalize').addEventListener('click',normalizeCurrency);$('hyperAwardProgress').addEventListener('click',recordProgress);$('hyperApplyProgress').addEventListener('click',()=>openModal('Apply Progression',advancementChecklist(),'',true));$('hyperProgressTarget')?.addEventListener('change',()=>{renderProgress();checkProgression(false)});$('hyperCopyPortalData').addEventListener('click',async()=>{const text=JSON.stringify(portalSnapshot(),null,2);try{await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);$('hyperCopyPortalData').textContent='Copied';setTimeout(()=>$('hyperCopyPortalData').textContent='Copy Portal Snapshot',1200)}catch(_){openModal('Portal Snapshot',`<div class="portal-contract">${html(text)}</div>`,'',true)}});$('hyperTogglePortalMode').addEventListener('click',()=>setPortalMode(!auto().portal.enabled));document.addEventListener('input',e=>{if(e.target.closest('#studio-automation,#frameEditor'))return;clearTimeout(window.__hyperUpdateTimer);window.__hyperUpdateTimer=setTimeout(updateAll,60)},true);document.addEventListener('change',e=>{if(e.target.closest('#studio-automation,#frameEditor'))return;setTimeout(updateAll,0)},true)}
function currentRollContract(){const s=stateRef();switch(CFG.id){case'fate-core':{const skill=s.skills?.find(x=>x.name===s.roll?.skill);return{kind:'fate_action',dice:'4dF',skill:s.roll?.skill,skill_rating:number(skill?.rating),modifier:number(s.roll?.modifier),invokes:number(s.roll?.invokeCount),opposition:number(s.roll?.opposition),action:s.roll?.action}}case'gurps-4e':return{kind:'gurps_success_roll',dice:'3d6',target:number(s.combat?.attackSkill)+number(s.combat?.attackModifier),roll_under:true};case'coc-7e':return{kind:'coc_percentile',dice:'d100',skill:s.roll?.skill,target:number(s.roll?.target),difficulty:s.roll?.difficulty,bonus_penalty:number(s.roll?.bonusPenalty)};case'daggerheart':return{kind:'daggerheart_action',dice:'2d12_hope_fear',trait:s.roll?.trait,trait_modifier:number(s.traits?.[s.roll?.trait]),modifier:number(s.roll?.modifier),advantage:number(s.roll?.advantage),difficulty:number(s.roll?.difficulty),experience_index:number(s.roll?.experienceIndex)};case'pathfinder-2e-remastered':return{kind:'pf2e_check',dice:'d20',type:s.roll?.type,key:s.roll?.key,dc:number(s.roll?.dc),modifier:number(s.roll?.modifier),map:number(s.roll?.map),agile:!!s.roll?.agile};case'pbta-adapter':{const move=s.moves?.[number(s.roll?.moveIndex)-1];const stat=s.stats?.find(x=>x.name===move?.stat);return{kind:'pbta_move',dice:s.adapter?.resolution,move:move?.name,stat:move?.stat,stat_value:number(stat?.value),modifier:number(s.roll?.modifier)+number(s.roll?.forward)+number(s.roll?.ongoing),bands:copy(s.adapter)}}case'swade':return{kind:'swade_trait',dice:`d${s.roll?.traitType==='attribute'?number(s.attributes?.[s.roll?.trait]):number(s.skills?.find(x=>x.name===s.roll?.trait)?.die)}${s.roll?.wildCard?'+wild d6':''}`,trait:s.roll?.trait,modifier:number(s.roll?.modifier)-(s.roll?.woundPenalty?number(s.resources?.wounds):0),target:number(s.roll?.target),acing:true};case'blades-in-the-dark':{const action=s.actions?.find(x=>x.name===s.roll?.action),pool=number(action?.rating)+number(s.roll?.bonus)+(s.roll?.push?1:0)+(s.roll?.assist?1:0)+(s.roll?.devilsBargain?1:0);return{kind:'bitd_action',dice_pool:pool,zero_dice:pool<=0,action:s.roll?.action,position:s.roll?.position,effect:s.roll?.effect}}case'dnd-5e-5.5e':return{kind:'dnd_d20_test',dice:'d20',level:totalLevel(),proficiency_bonus:2+Math.floor(Math.max(0,totalLevel()-1)/4),note:'Request a specific skill, save, initiative, attack, or spell action from the exported character state.'};default:return{kind:'custom'}}}
function resolveExternalRoll(payload={}){const c=currentRollContract(),s=stateRef();let out={system:CFG.id,kind:c.kind,received:copy(payload),at:now()};if(c.kind==='fate_action'){const dice=Array.isArray(payload.dice)?payload.dice.reduce((n,x)=>n+number(x),0):number(payload.diceTotal);const total=dice+c.skill_rating+c.modifier+c.invokes*2,shifts=total-c.opposition;out={...out,total,shifts,outcome:shifts<0?'Fail':shifts===0?'Tie':shifts<3?'Succeed':'Succeed with style'}}else if(c.kind==='gurps_success_roll'){const roll=number(payload.total),margin=c.target-roll;out={...out,total:roll,target:c.target,margin,outcome:roll<=c.target?'Success':'Failure'}}else if(c.kind==='coc_percentile'){const roll=number(payload.total),target=c.target,hard=Math.floor(target/2),extreme=Math.floor(target/5);let level=roll===1?'Critical':roll<=extreme?'Extreme':roll<=hard?'Hard':roll<=target?'Regular':roll>=96?'Fumble':'Failure';const needed=c.difficulty==='Extreme'?'Extreme':c.difficulty==='Hard'?'Hard':'Regular',rank={Failure:0,Fumble:0,Regular:1,Hard:2,Extreme:3,Critical:4};out={...out,total:roll,target,success:rank[level]>=rank[needed],level,needed}}else if(c.kind==='daggerheart_action'){const hope=number(payload.hope),fear=number(payload.fear),exp=c.experience_index>=0?number(s.experiences?.[c.experience_index]?.value):0,total=hope+fear+c.trait_modifier+c.modifier+exp+number(payload.advantageTotal),critical=hope===fear,duality=hope>=fear?'Hope':'Fear';out={...out,hope,fear,total,critical,duality,success:critical||total>=c.difficulty}}else if(c.kind==='pf2e_check'){const die=number(payload.die),baseMod=number(payload.totalModifier??c.modifier),total=die+baseMod,delta=total-c.dc;let degree=delta>=10?3:delta>=0?2:delta<=-10?0:1;if(die===20)degree=Math.min(3,degree+1);if(die===1)degree=Math.max(0,degree-1);out={...out,die,total,dc:c.dc,degree:['Critical Failure','Failure','Success','Critical Success'][degree]}}else if(c.kind==='pbta_move'){const dice=number(payload.total),total=dice+c.modifier,a=c.bands;let band=total>=number(a.advancedMin)?a.advancedLabel:total>=number(a.highMin)?a.hitLabel:total<=number(a.lowMax)?a.missLabel:a.mixedLabel;out={...out,dice,total,band}}else if(c.kind==='swade_trait'){const trait=number(payload.traitTotal),wild=payload.wildTotal===undefined?null:number(payload.wildTotal),best=wild===null?trait:Math.max(trait,wild),total=best+c.modifier,raises=total>=c.target?Math.floor((total-c.target)/4):0;out={...out,trait,wild,total,target:c.target,success:total>=c.target,raises}}else if(c.kind==='bitd_action'){const dice=Array.isArray(payload.dice)?payload.dice.map(number):[],sorted=[...dice].sort((a,b)=>b-a),highest=sorted[0]||0,critical=sorted.filter(x=>x===6).length>=2&&!c.zero_dice;out={...out,dice,highest,critical,outcome:critical?'Critical':highest===6?'Full success':highest>=4?'Partial success':'Bad outcome'}}else if(c.kind==='dnd_d20_test'){const die=number(payload.die),modifier=number(payload.modifier),total=die+modifier;out={...out,die,modifier,total,dc:payload.dc===undefined?null:number(payload.dc),success:payload.dc===undefined?null:total>=number(payload.dc)}}auto().portal.lastResult=out;auto().portal.lastRequest=c;schedule();renderPortal();window.parent!==window&&window.parent.postMessage({type:'TABLEGATE_ROLL_RESOLVED',payload:out},'*');return out}
function portalSnapshot(full=true){const s=stateRef();return{schema:'tablegate.character-sheet.v1',system:{id:CFG.id,name:CFG.name},character:{name:characterName(),profile:copy(profile())},derived:copy(s.computed?.outputs||{}),resources:copy(s.resources||s.hp||{}),progression:copy(auto().progression),currency:{summary:currencyTotal(),wallet:copy(Object.fromEntries(qa('[data-currency-key]').map(el=>[el.dataset.currencyKey,number(wallet()[el.dataset.currencyKey])]))),history:full?copy(auto().currency.history):undefined},roll_contract:currentRollContract(),state:full?copy(s):undefined,capabilities:{generates_dice:false,accepts_external_roll_results:true,automatic_math:true,progression_popups:true,currency_math:true,circle_crop_art:true,border_textures:true}}}
function notifyChange(){clearTimeout(window.__hyperNotifyTimer);window.__hyperNotifyTimer=setTimeout(()=>{const message={type:'TABLEGATE_SHEET_STATE_CHANGED',payload:portalSnapshot(false)};try{window.parent!==window&&window.parent.postMessage(message,'*')}catch(_){}window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('tablegate-sheet-change',{detail:message.payload}))},80)}
function setPortalMode(enabled){auto().portal.enabled=!!enabled;document.body.classList.toggle('portal-mode',!!enabled);schedule();renderPortal();return auto().portal.enabled}
function bindMessages(){window.addEventListener('message',e=>{const m=e.data;if(!m||typeof m!=='object'||!String(m.type||'').startsWith('TABLEGATE_'))return;auto().portal.connected=true;if(m.type==='TABLEGATE_GET_SHEET_STATE')e.source?.postMessage({type:'TABLEGATE_SHEET_STATE',requestId:m.requestId,payload:portalSnapshot()},e.origin==='null'?'*':e.origin);else if(m.type==='TABLEGATE_GET_ROLL_REQUEST')e.source?.postMessage({type:'TABLEGATE_ROLL_REQUEST',requestId:m.requestId,payload:currentRollContract()},e.origin==='null'?'*':e.origin);else if(m.type==='TABLEGATE_APPLY_ROLL_RESULT')resolveExternalRoll(m.payload||{});else if(m.type==='TABLEGATE_SET_PORTAL_MODE')setPortalMode(m.enabled!==false);else if(m.type==='TABLEGATE_IMPORT_CHARACTER'&&m.payload){try{if(typeof importObject==='function')importObject(m.payload);else if(typeof loadImported==='function')loadImported(m.payload);updateAll()}catch(err){e.source?.postMessage({type:'TABLEGATE_ERROR',message:String(err)},'*')}}});try{window.parent!==window&&window.parent.postMessage({type:'TABLEGATE_SHEET_READY',payload:portalSnapshot(false)},'*')}catch(_){} }
function wrapRender(){try{if(typeof renderAll==='function'&&!renderAll.__hyperWrapped){const old=renderAll;renderAll=function(){const r=old.apply(this,arguments);setTimeout(updateAll,0);return r};renderAll.__hyperWrapped=true}else if(typeof render==='function'&&!render.__hyperWrapped){const old=render;render=function(){const r=old.apply(this,arguments);setTimeout(updateAll,0);return r};render.__hyperWrapped=true}}catch(_){} }
function init(){auto();['frameEditor','studio-automation','hyperProgressModal'].forEach(id=>document.getElementById(id)?.remove());buildFrameEditor();applyFrames();buildAutomationModule();wrapRender();bindMessages();setPortalMode(auto().portal.enabled);updateAll();window.TableGateCharacterSheet={version:'1.0.0',system:CFG,getSnapshot:portalSnapshot,getRollRequest:currentRollContract,applyRollResult:resolveExternalRoll,setPortalMode,subscribe(fn){const h=e=>fn(e.detail);window.addEventListener('tablegate-sheet-change',h);return()=>window.removeEventListener('tablegate-sheet-change',h)},recalculate:updateAll};window.__HYPER_SHEET_TEST_API__={config:CFG,art:()=>copy(auto().artwork),progression:progressionInfo,currency:currencyTotal,audit:runAudit,snapshot:()=>portalSnapshot(false),resolve:resolveExternalRoll,modal:()=>$('hyperProgressModal')?.classList.contains('open')}}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',()=>setTimeout(init,0),{once:true});else setTimeout(init,0);

'use strict';
function initTrueMenu(){
  const bubble=document.getElementById('characterSheetBubble');
  const toggle=document.getElementById('characterSheetBubbleToggle');
  const panel=document.getElementById('characterSheetBubblePanel');
  if(!bubble||!toggle||!panel||bubble.dataset.trueMenuReady==='1')return;
  bubble.dataset.trueMenuReady='1';
  toggle.title='Open navigation and sheet design menu. Drag the button to move it.';
  panel.setAttribute('role','dialog');
  panel.setAttribute('aria-modal','true');
  panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  panel.setAttribute('tabindex','-1');

  const backdrop=document.createElement('button');
  backdrop.type='button';
  backdrop.className='cs-menu-backdrop';
  backdrop.setAttribute('aria-label','Close menu');
  bubble.insertBefore(backdrop,panel);

  const title=panel.querySelector('.cs-panel-title');
  const header=document.createElement('div');
  header.className='cs-menu-header';
  const close=document.createElement('button');
  close.type='button';
  close.className='cs-menu-close';
  close.setAttribute('aria-label','Close menu');
  close.textContent='×';
  panel.insertBefore(header,panel.firstChild);
  if(title)header.appendChild(title);
  header.appendChild(close);

  const navGroup=document.createElement('div');
  navGroup.className='cs-menu-nav';
  navGroup.innerHTML='<span class="cs-label">Quick navigation</span><div class="cs-menu-link-grid"></div>';
  header.insertAdjacentElement('afterend',navGroup);
  const grid=navGroup.querySelector('.cs-menu-link-grid');
  const navLinks=[...document.querySelectorAll('nav.nav a[href^="#"]')];
  const targets=[{label:'Top of Sheet',target:'__top'},...navLinks.map(a=>({label:(a.textContent||'Section').trim(),target:a.getAttribute('href').slice(1)})),{label:'Bottom of Sheet',target:'__bottom'}];
  const seen=new Set();
  targets.forEach(item=>{
    const key=item.target+'|'+item.label;
    if(seen.has(key))return;
    seen.add(key);
    const button=document.createElement('button');
    button.type='button';
    button.className='cs-menu-link';
    button.textContent=item.label;
    button.dataset.jumpTarget=item.target;
    grid.appendChild(button);
  });

  function closeMenu(returnFocus=false){
    bubble.classList.remove('open');
    toggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
    if(returnFocus)toggle.focus({preventScroll:true});
  }
  close.addEventListener('click',()=>closeMenu(true));
  backdrop.addEventListener('click',()=>closeMenu(true));
  grid.addEventListener('click',event=>{
    const button=event.target.closest('.cs-menu-link');
    if(!button)return;
    const target=button.dataset.jumpTarget;
    if(target==='__top')window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
    else if(target==='__bottom')window.scrollTo({top:document.documentElement.scrollHeight,behavior:'smooth'});
    else document.getElementById(target)?.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'});
    closeMenu(false);
  });

  let wasOpen=false;
  function syncOpenState(){
    const open=bubble.classList.contains('open');
    document.body.classList.toggle('cs-menu-open',open);
    panel.setAttribute('aria-hidden',String(!open));
    if(open!==wasOpen){
      if(open)requestAnimationFrame(()=>close.focus({preventScroll:true}));
      else if(panel.contains(document.activeElement))toggle.focus({preventScroll:true});
      wasOpen=open;
    }
  }
  new MutationObserver(syncOpenState).observe(bubble,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['class']});
  syncOpenState();
}
if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',initTrueMenu,{once:true});else initTrueMenu();
})();

function detectFields(){const out=[];document.querySelectorAll('input,select,textarea').forEach((el,i)=>{if(el.closest('#rules-homebrew-engine')||['button','file','hidden','checkbox','radio'].includes(el.type))return;let label='';if(el.id){const l=document.querySelector(`label[for="${CSS.escape(el.id)}"]`);if(l)label=l.textContent.trim()}if(!label){const l=el.closest('label');if(l)label=l.textContent.replace(el.value||'','').trim()}if(!label)label=el.getAttribute('aria-label')||el.placeholder||el.name||el.id||`Field ${i+1}`;out.push({token:el.id?'#'+el.id:'@'+i,label:label.slice(0,90),el})});return out}
function tokenize(expr){const s=String(expr||'').trim();if(!s)return[];const re=/\s*([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*|\d*\.\d+|\d+|[()+\-*/%,])\s*/gy;let m,pos=0,t=[];while((m=re.exec(s))){if(m.index!==pos)throw Error('Unexpected token near '+s.slice(pos,pos+12));t.push(m[1]);pos=re.lastIndex}if(pos!==s.length)throw Error('Unexpected token near '+s.slice(pos,pos+12));return t}
function evalExpr(expr,ctx){const t=tokenize(expr);let p=0;const peek=()=>t[p],take=()=>t[p++];function primary(){let x=take();if(x===undefined)throw Error('Incomplete formula');if(x==='('){let v=add();if(take()!==')')throw Error('Missing )');return v}if(x==='+'||x==='-'){let v=primary();return x==='-'?-v:v}if(/^\d/.test(x))return Number(x);if(/^[A-Za-z_]/.test(x)){if(peek()==='('){take();let a=[];if(peek()!==')'){while(true){a.push(add());if(peek()===','){take();continue}break}}if(take()!==')')throw Error('Missing ) after function');const f={min:Math.min,max:Math.max,floor:Math.floor,ceil:Math.ceil,round:Math.round,abs:Math.abs}[x.toLowerCase()];if(!f)throw Error('Unknown function '+x);return f(...a)}return Number(ctx[cleanKey(x)]??0)}throw Error('Unexpected '+x)}function mul(){let v=primary();while(['*','/','%'].includes(peek())){let o=take(),r=primary();v=o==='*'?v*r:o==='/'?(r===0?0:v/r):v%r}return v}function add(){let v=mul();while(['+','-'].includes(peek())){let o=take(),r=mul();v=o==='+'?v+r:v-r}return v}const v=add();if(p<t.length)throw Error('Unexpected '+peek());return Number.isFinite(v)?v:0}
function calculate(){const ctx={},detail={};state.bases.forEach(b=>{const k=cleanKey(b.key||b.label);if(!k)return;const v=Number(b.value)||0;ctx[k]=v;detail[k]={label:b.label||k,base:v,adds:[],mults:[],sets:[],mins:[],maxs:[],final:v}});const active=state.selected.filter(o=>o.active!==false);for(const o of active){for(const ef of o.effects||[]){const k=cleanKey(ef.target);if(!k)continue;if(!detail[k])detail[k]={label:ef.target||k,base:Number(ctx[k])||0,adds:[],mults:[],sets:[],mins:[],maxs:[],final:Number(ctx[k])||0};let v=0;try{v=evalExpr(ef.value,ctx)}catch(err){v=0;ef.error=err.message}const note={value:v,from:o.name,formula:ef.value};({add:'adds',multiply:'mults',set:'sets',min:'mins',max:'maxs'}[ef.op]&&detail[k][{add:'adds',multiply:'mults',set:'sets',min:'mins',max:'maxs'}[ef.op]].push(note))}}
for(const [k,d] of Object.entries(detail)){let v=d.base;d.adds.forEach(x=>v+=x.value);d.mults.forEach(x=>v*=x.value);d.sets.forEach(x=>v=x.value);d.mins.forEach(x=>v=Math.max(v,x.value));d.maxs.forEach(x=>v=Math.min(v,x.value));d.final=Number.isFinite(v)?v:0;ctx[k]=d.final}
// derived formulas: multiple passes for dependencies
for(let pass=0;pass<Math.max(2,state.formulas.length+1);pass++)for(const f of state.formulas){const k=cleanKey(f.key||f.label);if(!k)continue;try{const v=evalExpr(f.formula,ctx);ctx[k]=v;detail[k]={label:f.label||k,base:null,adds:[],mults:[],sets:[],mins:[],maxs:[],formula:f.formula,final:v}}catch(err){detail[k]={label:f.label||k,formula:f.formula,error:err.message,final:0};ctx[k]=0}}

function flatten(o,p='',out={}){if(o==null)return out;if(Array.isArray(o)){o.forEach((v,i)=>flatten(v,p?`${p}.${i}`:String(i),out));return out}if(typeof o==='object'){Object.entries(o).forEach(([k,v])=>flatten(v,p?`${p}.${k}`:k,out));return out}out[norm(p)]=o;return out}
function pick(flat,...keys){for(const k of keys){const nk=norm(k);if(flat[nk]!=null&&flat[nk]!=='')return flat[nk];for(const [p,v] of Object.entries(flat))if((p===nk||p.endsWith(' '+nk))&&v!=null&&v!=='')return v}return''}
function listFrom(v){if(Array.isArray(v))return v.map(x=>typeof x==='string'?x:(x?.name||x?.id||JSON.stringify(x)));return String(v||'').split(/\r?\n|\s*[;,|]\s*/).map(x=>x.trim()).filter(Boolean)}
function score(a,b){a=norm(a);b=norm(b);if(!a||!b)return 0;if(a===b)return 100;if(a.includes(b)||b.includes(a))return 76;const A=new Set(a.split(' ')),B=new Set(b.split(' '));let i=0;A.forEach(x=>B.has(x)&&i++);return 50*(2*i/(A.size+B.size||1))}
function catalog(sys,cat){const d=LEGAL[sys]||{}, n=norm(cat),out=[];Object.entries(d).forEach(([k,v])=>{if(norm(k)===n||norm(k).includes(n)||n.includes(norm(k)))out.push(...v)});const c=CURATED[sys]||{};Object.entries(c).forEach(([k,v])=>{if(norm(k)===n||norm(k).includes(n)||n.includes(norm(k)))out.push(...v)});return uniq(out)}
function bestLegal(sys,cat,wanted,fallback,report,reason=''){const options=catalog(sys,cat);if(!options.length){const val=wanted||fallback||'';if(val)report.review.push(`${cat}: “${val}” could not be fully catalog-validated; retained for DM/GM/MOL review.`);return val}let best='',bestScore=-1;for(const o of options){const s=score(wanted,o);if(s>bestScore){best=o;bestScore=s}}if(wanted&&bestScore>=74)return best;const chosen=fallback&&options.find(o=>norm(o)===norm(fallback))||best||options[0];if(wanted&&norm(wanted)!==norm(chosen))report.replacements.push({category:cat,from:wanted,to:chosen,reason:reason||'No exact legal target-system match.'});return chosen}

function abilityNumber(v){if(v&&typeof v==='object')return num(v.base)+num(v.origin)+num(v.other);return num(v)}
function canonicalBase(){return{sourceSystem:'unknown',name:'',player:'',campaign:'',concept:'',pronouns:'',gender:'',ancestry:'',heritage:'',background:'',occupation:'',classes:[],level:1,abilities:{},skills:[],feats:[],spells:[],attacks:[],equipment:[],resources:[],languages:[],proficiencies:[],notes:{appearance:'',personality:'',backstory:'',relationships:'',session:''},hp:0,ac:0,speed:0,raw:null,sourceText:''}}
function canonicalDnd(obj){const s=obj.character||obj,c=canonicalBase(),p=s.profile||{};c.sourceSystem='dnd';c.name=p.characterName||p.name||'';c.player=p.playerName||p.player||'';c.campaign=p.campaignName||p.campaign||'';c.pronouns=p.pronouns==='Write in…'?p.pronounsWriteIn:p.pronouns;c.gender=p.genderIdentity==='Write in…'?p.genderWriteIn:p.genderIdentity;c.ancestry=p.race==='__writein__'?p.raceWriteIn:p.race;c.heritage=p.raceOption==='__writein__'?p.raceOptionWriteIn:p.raceOption;c.background=p.background==='__writein__'?p.backgroundWriteIn:p.background;c.classes=arr(s.classes).map(x=>({name:x.name||'',level:num(x.level,1),subclass:x.subclass||''})).filter(x=>x.name);c.level=c.classes.reduce((n,x)=>n+x.level,0)||1;Object.entries(s.abilities||{}).forEach(([k,v])=>c.abilities[k]=abilityNumber(v));c.skills=Object.entries(s.skills||{}).map(([name,v])=>({name,value:num(v.rank),rank:num(v.rank),ability:v.ability||'',misc:num(v.misc)}));c.attacks=arr(s.attacks).map(x=>({...x,name:x.name||'Attack'}));c.spells=arr(s.spells).map(x=>({name:title(x.name||x.id||''),...x})).filter(x=>x.name);c.equipment=arr(s.items).map(x=>({...x,name:x.name||'Item'}));c.resources=arr(s.customResources);c.languages=listFrom(s.languages);c.proficiencies=listFrom(s.proficiencies);c.hp=num(s.hp?.current||s.hp?.max);c.ac=num(s.combat?.acOverride||s.combat?.armorBase)+num(s.combat?.shieldBonus)+num(s.combat?.miscAC);c.speed=30+num(s.combat?.speedMisc);c.notes={...c.notes,...(s.notes||{})};const explicit=[];arr(s.levelHistory).forEach(h=>arr(h.features).forEach(f=>{if(/feat\s*:/i.test(f)||/ability score improvement/i.test(f))explicit.push(String(f))}));const origin=s.jasperGuidance?.sourceCharacter?.background?.origin_feat?.name;if(origin)explicit.push(origin);c.feats=uniq(explicit);c.raw=s;return c}
function canonicalNative(obj,sys){const s=obj.character||obj,c=canonicalBase(),p=s.profile||{};c.sourceSystem=sys;c.name=p.name||p.characterName||'';c.player=p.player||p.playerName||'';c.campaign=p.campaign||p.campaignName||'';c.concept=p.concept||'';c.pronouns=p.pronouns||'';c.ancestry=p.ancestry||p.race||'';c.heritage=p.heritage||p.raceOption||'';c.background=p.background||'';c.occupation=p.occupation||'';c.level=num(p.level||s.level,1);c.raw=s;
 if(sys==='pathfinder'){Object.entries(s.attributes||{}).forEach(([k,v])=>c.abilities[k.toUpperCase()]=num(v));c.classes=p.className?[{name:p.className,level:c.level,subclass:''}]:[];c.skills=Object.entries(s.skills||{}).map(([name,v])=>({name,rank:num(v.rank),value:num(v.rank),misc:num(v.misc)}));c.feats=arr(s.feats);c.spells=arr(s.spells);c.attacks=arr(s.attacks);c.equipment=arr(s.inventory);c.hp=num(s.hp?.current);c.speed=num(p.speed)}
 else if(sys==='daggerheart'){c.classes=p.className?[{name:p.className,level:c.level,subclass:p.subclass||''}]:[];c.ancestry=p.ancestry;c.background=p.community;Object.assign(c.abilities,s.traits||{});c.skills=arr(s.experiences).map(x=>({name:x.name||'Experience',value:num(x.modifier)}));c.feats=[...arr(s.features),...arr(s.cards)];c.attacks=arr(s.weapons);c.equipment=arr(s.inventory);c.hp=num(s.resources?.hpMax)-num(s.resources?.hpMarked)}
 else if(sys==='fate'){c.concept=p.concept;c.skills=arr(s.skills).map(x=>({name:x.name,value:num(x.rating)}));c.feats=arr(s.stunts);c.notes.personality=Object.values(s.aspects||{}).filter(Boolean).join('\n');}
 else if(sys==='gurps'){Object.assign(c.abilities,s.attributes||{});c.skills=arr(s.skills).map(x=>({name:x.name,value:num(x.level||x.points),...x}));c.feats=[...arr(s.advantages),...arr(s.disadvantages),...arr(s.quirks)];c.attacks=arr(s.attacks);c.equipment=arr(s.equipment);c.hp=num(s.combat?.hpCurrent)}
 else if(sys==='coc'){Object.assign(c.abilities,s.characteristics||{});c.skills=arr(s.skills).map(x=>({name:x.name,value:num(x.value)}));c.attacks=arr(s.weapons);c.spells=arr(s.spells);c.equipment=arr(s.tomes);c.hp=num(s.resources?.hpCurrent);c.background=p.occupation}
 else if(sys==='swade'){Object.assign(c.abilities,s.attributes||{});c.skills=arr(s.skills).map(x=>({name:x.name,value:num(x.die),...x}));c.feats=[...arr(s.edges),...arr(s.hindrances)];c.spells=arr(s.powers);c.attacks=arr(s.weapons);c.equipment=arr(s.gear);c.ancestry=p.ancestry;c.level=Math.max(1,arr(s.advances).length+1)}
 else if(sys==='blades'){c.classes=p.playbook?[{name:p.playbook,level:1,subclass:''}]:[];c.ancestry=p.heritage;c.background=p.background;c.skills=arr(s.actions).map(x=>({name:x.name,value:num(x.rating),rank:num(x.rating)}));c.feats=arr(s.abilities);c.equipment=arr(s.items);c.notes.personality=[p.vice,p.look].filter(Boolean).join('\n')}
 else if(sys==='pbta'){c.classes=p.playbook?[{name:p.playbook,level:1,subclass:''}]:[];c.skills=arr(s.stats).map(x=>({name:x.name,value:num(x.value)}));c.feats=arr(s.moves);c.equipment=arr(s.gear);c.concept=p.concept}
 return c}
function detectSystem(obj){const hint=norm(obj?.system_id||obj?.system||obj?.schema||obj?.metadata?.system||'');if(hint.includes('dnd'))return'dnd';if(hint.includes('pathfinder'))return'pathfinder';if(hint.includes('dagger'))return'daggerheart';if(hint.includes('cthulhu')||hint==='coc')return'coc';if(hint.includes('gurps'))return'gurps';if(hint.includes('savage')||hint.includes('swade'))return'swade';if(hint.includes('blade'))return'blades';if(hint.includes('pbta')||hint.includes('powered'))return'pbta';if(hint.includes('fate'))return'fate';const s=obj?.character||obj;if(s?.profile?.edition&&s?.abilities&&s?.classes)return'dnd';if(s?.profile?.className&&s?.attributes&&s?.heroPoints!=null)return'pathfinder';if(s?.traits&&s?.thresholds&&s?.cards)return'daggerheart';if(s?.characteristics&&s?.resources?.sanCurrent!=null)return'coc';if(s?.budget&&s?.adjustments&&s?.advantages)return'gurps';if(s?.edges&&s?.hindrances&&s?.resources?.bennies!=null)return'swade';if(s?.actions&&s?.crew&&s?.score)return'blades';if(s?.adapter&&s?.moves&&s?.conversation)return'pbta';if(s?.aspects&&s?.fatePoints!=null)return'fate';return'unknown'}
function canonicalJson(obj){const sys=detectSystem(obj);return sys==='dnd'?canonicalDnd(obj):sys!=='unknown'?canonicalNative(obj,sys):canonicalFromFlat(obj)}
function keyMatch(k,names){const n=norm(k);return names.some(x=>n===norm(x))}
function collectValues(obj,names,out=[]){if(!obj||typeof obj!=='object')return out;const walk=(v,k='')=>{if(k&&keyMatch(k,names)){out.push(v);return}if(Array.isArray(v))v.forEach(x=>walk(x));else if(v&&typeof v==='object')Object.entries(v).forEach(([a,b])=>walk(b,a))};walk(obj);return out}
function recordList(v){if(v==null||v==='')return[];if(Array.isArray(v))return v.flatMap(recordList);if(typeof v==='object'){if(v.name||v.id||v.title||v.className||v.playbook)return[v];return Object.entries(v).flatMap(([k,x])=>{if(x&&typeof x==='object')return[{name:x.name||x.id||x.title||k,...x}];return[{name:k,value:x}]})}return listFrom(v).map(name=>({name}))}
function collectRecords(obj,names){const out=collectValues(obj,names).flatMap(recordList),seen=new Set();return out.filter(x=>{const k=norm(x?.name||x?.id||x?.title||JSON.stringify(x));if(!k||seen.has(k))return false;seen.add(k);return true})}
function sectionText(t,labels){const wanted=labels.map(norm),lines=String(t||'').replace(/\u0000/g,'').split(/\r?\n/);let active=false,out=[];for(const raw of lines){const line=raw.trim();if(!line)continue;const h=line.match(/^#{0,3}\s*([A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9 /&'’_-]{1,55})\s*:?[ \t]*$/);if(h){const n=norm(h[1]),hit=wanted.some(x=>n===x||n.includes(x)||x.includes(n));if(hit){active=true;continue}if(active)break}if(active)out.push(line.replace(/^[-*•]\s*/,''))}return out.join('\n')}
function fieldText(flat,t,keys){const v=pick(flat,...keys);return v!==''&&v!=null?text(v):sectionText(t,keys)}
function skillRecords(v){return recordList(v).map(x=>{if(typeof x!=='object')return{name:String(x)};const raw=x.name||'';const m=String(raw).match(/^(.*?)(?:\s*(?:[:=]|\+)\s*(-?\d+))\s*$/);return m&&m[2]!=null?{...x,name:m[1].trim(),value:num(m[2]),rank:num(m[2])}:x})}
function canonicalFromFlat(objOrText){const c=canonicalBase(),isText=typeof objOrText==='string',t=isText?objOrText:'',src=isText?null:objOrText;let flat=isText?parseTextFlat(t):flatten(objOrText);c.name=String(pick(flat,'character name','charactername','investigator name','scoundrel name','name'));c.player=String(pick(flat,'player name','player'));c.campaign=String(pick(flat,'campaign name','campaign','setting'));c.pronouns=String(pick(flat,'pronouns'));c.gender=String(pick(flat,'gender identity','gender'));c.ancestry=String(pick(flat,'race species','race','species','ancestry','heritage ancestry'));c.heritage=String(pick(flat,'subrace','heritage','versatile heritage'));c.background=String(pick(flat,'background','occupation','community'));c.occupation=String(pick(flat,'occupation'));c.concept=String(pick(flat,'concept','high concept','archetype','look'));const lvl=num(pick(flat,'level','character level','tier'),1),classRows=src?collectRecords(src,['classes','class','className','playbook']):[];if(classRows.length)c.classes=classRows.map(x=>({name:String(x.name||x.className||x.playbook||''),level:num(x.level,lvl),subclass:String(x.subclass||x.specialization||'')})).filter(x=>x.name);else{const cls=fieldText(flat,t,['class','class name','classes','playbook']);if(cls)c.classes=parseClasses(cls,lvl)}c.level=c.classes.reduce((n,x)=>n+x.level,0)||lvl;const aliases={Strength:['strength','str'],Dexterity:['dexterity','dex'],Constitution:['constitution','con'],Intelligence:['intelligence','int','iq'],Wisdom:['wisdom','wis'],Charisma:['charisma','cha'],ST:['st'],DX:['dx'],IQ:['iq'],HT:['ht'],POW:['pow'],EDU:['edu'],SIZ:['siz'],APP:['app']};Object.entries(aliases).forEach(([k,ks])=>{for(const x of ks){const v=pick(flat,x);if(v!==''&&v!=null){c.abilities[k]=num(v);break}}});const skillSource=src?collectRecords(src,['skills','skill list','actions','experiences']):[];c.skills=skillSource.length?skillRecords(skillSource):skillRecords(fieldText(flat,t,['skills','skill proficiencies','actions','experiences']));c.feats=src?collectRecords(src,['feats','features','class features','special abilities','stunts','advantages','edges','moves','domain cards']):[];if(!c.feats.length)c.feats=recordList(fieldText(flat,t,['feats','features','special abilities','stunts','advantages','edges','moves']));c.spells=src?collectRecords(src,['spells','spell list','powers','rituals']):[];if(!c.spells.length)c.spells=recordList(fieldText(flat,t,['spells','spell list','powers','rituals']));c.attacks=src?collectRecords(src,['attacks','weapons','combat actions']):[];if(!c.attacks.length)c.attacks=recordList(fieldText(flat,t,['attacks','weapons','combat actions']));c.equipment=src?collectRecords(src,['equipment','items','inventory','gear']):[];if(!c.equipment.length)c.equipment=recordList(fieldText(flat,t,['equipment','items','inventory','gear']));c.resources=src?collectRecords(src,['resources','resource trackers','pools']):[];if(!c.resources.length)c.resources=recordList(fieldText(flat,t,['resources','resource trackers','pools']));const langValues=src?collectValues(src,['languages','language']):[];c.languages=uniq((langValues.length?langValues:[fieldText(flat,t,['languages','language'])]).flatMap(listFrom));const profValues=src?collectValues(src,['proficiencies','proficiency','trainings']):[];c.proficiencies=uniq((profValues.length?profValues:[fieldText(flat,t,['proficiencies','proficiency','trainings'])]).flatMap(listFrom));c.hp=num(pick(flat,'hit points','hp current','hp','health'));c.ac=num(pick(flat,'armor class','ac','defense'));c.speed=num(pick(flat,'speed','pace','move'));c.notes.appearance=fieldText(flat,t,['appearance','look']);c.notes.personality=fieldText(flat,t,['personality','traits','ideals bonds flaws']);c.notes.backstory=fieldText(flat,t,['backstory','history','background story']);c.notes.relationships=fieldText(flat,t,['relationships','bonds','connections','contacts']);c.sourceText=isText?t:JSON.stringify(objOrText,null,2);c.notes.session=isText?t.slice(0,30000):fieldText(flat,'',['session notes','notes','campaign notes'])||('Unmapped source data retained for review:\n'+c.sourceText.slice(0,30000));return c}
function parseClasses(v,defaultLevel=1){return String(v||'').split(/\s*[/,;|]\s*/).map(x=>{let m=x.match(/^(.*?)(?:\s+(\d+))?(?:\s*\((.*?)\))?$/);return{name:(m?.[1]||x).trim(),level:num(m?.[2],defaultLevel),subclass:(m?.[3]||'').trim()}}).filter(x=>x.name)}
function parseTextFlat(t){const out={};let section='';String(t||'').replace(/\u0000/g,'').split(/\r?\n/).forEach((raw,i)=>{const line=raw.trim();if(!line)return;if(/^#{0,3}\s*[A-Za-z][A-Za-z /&-]{2,40}:?$/.test(line)&&!/[0-9]/.test(line)){section=norm(line.replace(/[:#]/g,''));return}let m=line.match(/^([^:=]{2,45})\s*[:=]\s*(.+)$/);if(m)out[norm((section?section+' ':'')+m[1])]=m[2].trim();else{m=line.match(/^(STR|DEX|CON|INT|WIS|CHA|POW|EDU|SIZ|APP|ST|DX|IQ|HT)\s*[=: ]\s*(-?\d+)/i);if(m)out[norm(m[1])]=m[2];else out[`line ${i}`]=line}});return out}
async function docxText(file){if(!window.JSZip)throw Error('DOCX support library did not load.');const z=await JSZip.loadAsync(await file.arrayBuffer());const names=Object.keys(z.files).filter(n=>/^word\/(?:document|header\d+|footer\d+|comments\d*|footnotes|endnotes)\.xml$/i.test(n)).sort((a,b)=>a==='word/document.xml'?-1:b==='word/document.xml'?1:a.localeCompare(b));let out=[];for(const n of names){const f=z.file(n);if(!f)continue;const xml=await f.async('string');const d=new DOMParser().parseFromString(xml,'application/xml');d.querySelectorAll('w\\:p,p').forEach(p=>{const t=Array.from(p.querySelectorAll('w\\:t,t')).map(x=>x.textContent).join('');if(t.trim())out.push(t.trim())})}if(!out.length)throw Error('No readable character text was found in the DOCX file.');return out.join('\n')}
function pdfStringDecode(s){let out='';for(let i=0;i<s.length;i++){let c=s[i];if(c==='\\'){let n=s[++i]||'';if(/[nrtbf]/.test(n))out+=({n:'\n',r:'\r',t:'\t',b:'\b',f:'\f'}[n]);else if(/[0-7]/.test(n)){let oct=n;for(let j=0;j<2&&/[0-7]/.test(s[i+1]||'');j++)oct+=s[++i];out+=String.fromCharCode(parseInt(oct,8))}else out+=n}else out+=c}return out}
function pdfHexDecode(h){const b=[];for(let i=0;i<h.length;i+=2)b.push(parseInt(h.slice(i,i+2).padEnd(2,'0'),16));if(b[0]===0xFE&&b[1]===0xFF){let out='';for(let i=2;i+1<b.length;i+=2)out+=String.fromCharCode((b[i]<<8)|b[i+1]);return out}try{return new TextDecoder('utf-8').decode(new Uint8Array(b))}catch(_){return String.fromCharCode(...b)}}
async function inflatePdf(data){try{const ds=new DecompressionStream('deflate');return new Uint8Array(await new Response(new Blob([data]).stream().pipeThrough(ds)).arrayBuffer())}catch(_){return null}}
function bytesToLatin(b){let out='',step=0x8000;for(let i=0;i<b.length;i+=step)out+=String.fromCharCode(...b.subarray(i,Math.min(b.length,i+step)));return out}
function extractPdfStrings(s){let out=[];const lit=/\((?:\\.|[^\\)])*\)\s*(?:Tj|'|")/gs;for(const m of s.matchAll(lit))out.push(pdfStringDecode(m[0].slice(1,m[0].lastIndexOf(')'))));for(const m of s.matchAll(/<([0-9A-Fa-f]+)>\s*(?:Tj|'|")/g))out.push(pdfHexDecode(m[1]));const arrays=/\[((?:.|\n)*?)\]\s*TJ/gs;for(const m of s.matchAll(arrays)){let line=[];for(const x of m[1].matchAll(/\((?:\\.|[^\\)])*\)|<([0-9A-Fa-f]+)>/g)){if(x[0][0]==='(')line.push(pdfStringDecode(x[0].slice(1,-1)));else line.push(pdfHexDecode(x[1]))}out.push(line.join(''))}return out}
async function pdfText(file){const b=new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer()),raw=bytesToLatin(b),out=[];for(const m of raw.matchAll(/\/(?:T|TU|TM|V)\s*(\((?:\\.|[^\\)])*\)|<([0-9A-Fa-f]+)>)/gs)){const token=m[1];out.push(token[0]==='('?pdfStringDecode(token.slice(1,-1)):pdfHexDecode(m[2]))}for(const sm of raw.matchAll(/<<(.*?)>>\s*stream\r?\n([\s\S]*?)\r?\nendstream/gs)){let data=new Uint8Array([...sm[2]].map(c=>c.charCodeAt(0)&255));if(/FlateDecode/.test(sm[1])){const d=await inflatePdf(data);if(d)data=d;else continue}out.push(...extractPdfStrings(bytesToLatin(data)))}const cleaned=uniq(out.map(x=>x.replace(/[\x00-\x08\x0b\x0c\x0e-\x1f]/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim()).filter(x=>x.length>1));if(cleaned.length<3)throw Error('No usable text fields were found. This may be a scanned/image-only PDF; export it as JSON/TXT or run OCR first.');return cleaned.join('\n')}
async function readFile(file){const ext=(file.name.split('.').pop()||'').toLowerCase();if(ext==='json'||/json/.test(file.type)){const t=await file.text();return{kind:'json',data:JSON.parse(t),text:t}}if(ext==='txt'||/text\//.test(file.type)){const t=await file.text();return{kind:'text',data:t,text:t}}if(ext==='docx'){const t=await docxText(file);return{kind:'text',data:t,text:t}}if(ext==='pdf'||file.type==='application/pdf'){const t=await pdfText(file);return{kind:'text',data:t,text:t}}throw Error('Supported character imports: JSON, TXT, DOCX, and text/fillable PDF.')}
function totalAbility(c,name,...aliases){for(const k of [name,...aliases])if(c.abilities[k]!=null)return num(c.abilities[k]);return 10}
function abilityMod(score){return Math.floor((num(score)-10)/2)}
function noteConversion(s,c,report){const block=['Universal conversion source: '+c.sourceSystem,report.replacements.length?'Automatic legal replacements:\n'+report.replacements.map(x=>`• ${x.category}: ${x.from} → ${x.to} (${x.reason})`).join('\n'):'No automatic option replacements were required.',report.review.length?'Review required:\n'+report.review.map(x=>'• '+x).join('\n'):''].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');if(s.notes&&typeof s.notes==='object'){const k='sessionNotes' in s.notes?'sessionNotes':('session' in s.notes?'session':'campaign');s.notes[k]=[s.notes[k],block].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n')}else if(s.story)s.story.notes=[s.story.notes,block].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');else if(s.background&&typeof s.background==='object')s.background.traits=[s.background.traits,block].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n');return s}

function adaptCoc(c,s,r){s.profile={...(s.profile||{}),name:c.name||'',player:c.player||'',campaign:c.campaign||'',concept:c.concept||'',pronouns:c.pronouns||'',occupation:bestLegal('coc','Occupation',c.occupation||c.background||c.classes[0]?.name,'Investigator',r,'Converted to the nearest Call of Cthulhu occupation.')};const val=(n,...a)=>clamp(Math.round(totalAbility(c,n,...a)*5),15,99);s.characteristics={...(s.characteristics||{}),STR:val('Strength','STR','ST'),CON:val('Constitution','CON','HT'),SIZ:clamp(Math.round((val('Strength','STR')+val('Constitution','CON'))/2),15,99),DEX:val('Dexterity','DEX','DX'),APP:val('Charisma','CHA','APP'),INT:val('Intelligence','INT','IQ'),POW:val('Wisdom','WIS','POW'),EDU:val('Intelligence','INT','EDU')};s.skills=(s.skills||[]).map(row=>{const src=c.skills.find(x=>norm(x.name)===norm(row.name));return src?{...row,value:clamp(20+num(src.rank||src.value)*15,1,99)}:row});s.weapons=c.attacks.map(x=>({name:x.name||'Weapon',skill:'Fighting (Brawl)',damage:x.damageDice||x.damage||'1D3',range:x.range||'Touch',attacks:1,ammo:'',malfunction:'',notes:x.notes||''}));s.spells=c.spells.map(x=>({name:x.name||title(x.id),cost:'',sanity:'',castingTime:'',notes:'Converted supernatural ability; Keeper approval required.'}));s.background=s.background||{};s.background.traits=[s.background.traits,c.notes.personality,c.notes.backstory].filter(Boolean).join('\n');return noteConversion(s,c,r)}
function dieFromScore(v){const m=abilityMod(v);return clamp(4+Math.max(0,m)*2,4,12)}
function adaptSwade(c,s,r){s.profile={...(s.profile||{}),name:c.name||'',player:c.player||'',campaign:c.campaign||'',concept:c.concept||'',pronouns:c.pronouns||'',ancestry:c.ancestry||'Human'};s.attributes={Agility:dieFromScore(totalAbility(c,'Dexterity','DEX','DX')),Smarts:dieFromScore(totalAbility(c,'Intelligence','INT','IQ')),Spirit:dieFromScore(totalAbility(c,'Wisdom','WIS','POW')),Strength:dieFromScore(totalAbility(c,'Strength','STR','ST')),Vigor:dieFromScore(totalAbility(c,'Constitution','CON','HT'))};s.skills=c.skills.slice(0,20).map(x=>({name:bestLegal('swade','Skill',x.name,'Common Knowledge',r,'Converted to the closest SWADE skill.'),attribute:/arcana|history|invest|nature|relig/i.test(x.name)?'Smarts':/persu|decep|perform|intimid/i.test(x.name)?'Spirit':'Agility',die:clamp(4+num(x.rank||x.value)*2,4,12)}));s.edges=uniq([...c.feats.map(x=>typeof x==='string'?x:x.name),...c.classes.map(x=>mapClass('swade',x.name))]).filter(Boolean).slice(0,10).map(name=>({name:bestLegal('swade','Edge',name,'Alertness',r,'Converted to a legal thematic Edge.'),cost:2,notes:`Converted from ${name}. Verify Rank and requirements.`}));s.weapons=c.attacks.map(x=>({name:x.name||'Weapon',skill:/range|bow|gun|launcher/i.test((x.range||'')+' '+x.name)?'Shooting':'Fighting',damage:x.damageDice||x.damage||'Str+d6',ap:0,range:x.range||'',rof:1,shots:'',notes:x.notes||''}));s.powers=c.spells.slice(0,20).map(x=>({name:bestLegal('swade','Power',x.name||title(x.id),'Bolt',r,'Converted to the nearest SWADE power.'),cost:0,range:'',duration:'',trappings:x.notes||''}));s.gear=c.equipment.map(x=>({name:x.name||'Item',qty:num(x.qty,1),weight:num(x.weight),cost:0,notes:x.notes||''}));return noteConversion(s,c,r)}
function adaptDaggerheart(c,s,r){s.profile={...(s.profile||{}),name:c.name||'',player:c.player||'',campaign:c.campaign||'',concept:c.concept||'',pronouns:c.pronouns||'',level:clamp(c.level||1,1,10)};const primary=[...c.classes].sort((a,b)=>b.level-a.level)[0]||{name:'Warrior',subclass:''};s.profile.className=bestLegal('daggerheart','Class',mapClass('daggerheart',primary.name),'Warrior',r,'Converted to a legal Daggerheart class.');s.profile.subclass=bestLegal('daggerheart','Subclass',primary.subclass,s.profile.className==='Bard'?'Troubadour':'Call of the Brave',r,'Converted to a legal subclass.');s.profile.ancestry=bestLegal('daggerheart','Ancestry',mapAncestry('daggerheart',c.ancestry),'Human',r,'Converted to the closest Daggerheart ancestry.');s.profile.community=bestLegal('daggerheart','Community',c.background,'Wanderborne',r,'Converted background to a Daggerheart community.');const vals=[['Agility','Dexterity','DEX'],['Strength','Strength','STR'],['Finesse','Dexterity','DEX'],['Instinct','Wisdom','WIS'],['Presence','Charisma','CHA'],['Knowledge','Intelligence','INT']];s.traits=s.traits||{};vals.forEach(([k,a,b])=>s.traits[k]=clamp(abilityMod(totalAbility(c,a,b)),-1,3));s.experiences=c.skills.sort((a,b)=>num(b.rank||b.value)-num(a.rank||a.value)).slice(0,5).map(x=>({name:x.name,modifier:2,notes:'Converted proficiency/expertise.'}));s.weapons=c.attacks.map(x=>({name:x.name||'Weapon',trait:/range|launcher|bow/i.test((x.range||'')+x.name)?'Finesse':'Strength',range:x.range||'Melee',damage:x.damageDice||x.damage||'d8 phy',burden:'One-Handed',feature:x.notes||''}));s.cards=c.spells.slice(0,20).map(x=>({name:x.name||title(x.id),domain:'Codex',level:Math.min(10,num(x.level||x.rank,1)),recallCost:0,notes:'Converted spell; replace with a legal domain card at the chosen level.'}));s.inventory=c.equipment.map(x=>({name:x.name||'Item',qty:num(x.qty,1),notes:x.notes||''}));return noteConversion(s,c,r)}
function adaptBlades(c,s,r){s.profile={...(s.profile||{}),name:c.name||'',player:c.player||'',campaign:c.campaign||'',concept:c.concept||'',pronouns:c.pronouns||''};const primary=[...c.classes].sort((a,b)=>b.level-a.level)[0]||{name:'Cutter'};s.profile.playbook=bestLegal('blades','Playbook',mapClass('blades',primary.name),'Cutter',r,'Converted to the closest Blades playbook.');s.profile.heritage=bestLegal('blades','Heritage',mapAncestry('blades',c.ancestry),'Akoros',r,'Converted ancestry to a setting heritage.');s.profile.background=bestLegal('blades','Background',/artific|engineer|invent/i.test(c.background+primary.name)?'Trade':/perform|bard/i.test(c.background+primary.name)?'Underworld':c.background,'Trade',r,'Converted to a legal background.');s.profile.vice=bestLegal('blades','Vice',/faith|cleric|paladin/i.test(c.background+primary.name)?'Faith':'Obligation','Obligation',r,'Selected a legal vice for the converted concept.');const actionMap={arcana:'Attune',investigation:'Study',perception:'Survey',stealth:'Prowl',acrobatics:'Prowl',athletics:'Skirmish',deception:'Sway',persuasion:'Consort',performance:'Sway',sleightofhand:'Finesse',intimidation:'Command',survival:'Hunt',crafting:'Tinker'};c.skills.forEach(sk=>{const n=actionMap[norm(sk.name).replace(/ /g,'')]||bestLegal('blades','',sk.name,'Study',r);const row=s.actions.find(x=>norm(x.name)===norm(n));if(row)row.rating=clamp(num(sk.rank||sk.value),0,4)});s.abilities=uniq([...c.feats.map(x=>typeof x==='string'?x:x.name),...c.classes.map(x=>x.subclass)]).filter(Boolean).slice(0,4).map(name=>({name:bestLegal('blades','Special Ability',name,'Veteran',r,'Converted to a legal special ability.'),notes:`Converted from ${name}.`}));s.items=c.equipment.slice(0,12).map(x=>({name:x.name||'Item',load:1,marked:!!x.equipped,notes:x.notes||''}));return noteConversion(s,c,r)}
function adaptPbta(c,s,r){s.profile={...(s.profile||{}),name:c.name||'',player:c.player||'',campaign:c.campaign||'',concept:c.concept||'',pronouns:c.pronouns||'',gameTitle:s.profile?.gameTitle||'Custom PbtA game',playbook:c.classes[0]?.name||c.background||'Custom Playbook'};const vals=[['Hard','Strength','STR'],['Cool','Dexterity','DEX'],['Sharp','Intelligence','INT'],['Hot','Charisma','CHA'],['Weird','Wisdom','WIS']];s.stats=vals.map(([name,a,b])=>({name,value:clamp(abilityMod(totalAbility(c,a,b)),-2,3)}));s.moves=uniq([...c.feats.map(x=>typeof x==='string'?x:x.name),...c.spells.map(x=>x.name||title(x.id)),...c.classes.map(x=>x.subclass)]).filter(Boolean).slice(0,12).map(name=>({name,trigger:`When you use ${name} in the fiction…`,stat:'',on10:'Strong hit; define with the chosen PbtA game.',on7:'Mixed hit; define with the chosen PbtA game.',onMiss:'The facilitator makes a move.',notes:'Converted concept only because PbtA is not one universal rules system.'}));s.gear=c.equipment.map(x=>({name:x.name||'Item',tags:'',uses:num(x.qty,1),notes:x.notes||''}));r.review.push('PbtA conversion requires choosing a specific PbtA game; the adapter preserves concept, stats, moves, and gear without pretending every PbtA title shares one legal option list.');return noteConversion(s,c,r)}
function adapt(c,target,s,r){if(target==='dnd')return adaptDnd(c,s,r);if(target==='pathfinder')return adaptPathfinder(c,s,r);if(target==='fate')return adaptFate(c,s,r);if(target==='gurps')return adaptGurps(c,s,r);if(target==='coc')return adaptCoc(c,s,r);if(target==='swade')return adaptSwade(c,s,r);if(target==='daggerheart')return adaptDaggerheart(c,s,r);if(target==='blades')return adaptBlades(c,s,r);if(target==='pbta')return adaptPbta(c,s,r);return s}
function sanitizeNative(c,target,r){const s=clone(c.raw||{});if(target==='dnd'){s.profile=s.profile||{};const chosen=s.profile.race==='__writein__'?s.profile.raceWriteIn:s.profile.race;if(chosen){s.profile.race=chosen;s.profile.raceWriteIn=''}else{s.profile.race='';s.profile.raceWriteIn=''}const option=s.profile.raceOption==='__writein__'?s.profile.raceOptionWriteIn:s.profile.raceOption;s.profile.raceOption=option||'';s.profile.raceOptionWriteIn='';if(s.profile.background&&s.profile.background!=='__writein__')s.profile.backgroundWriteIn='';r.review.push('Native D&D structured fields were preserved. Race/species was taken only from character.profile, never from descriptive guidance or legacy notes.')}else r.review.push(`Native ${target} sheet state was preserved without cross-system remapping.`);return s}
function previewFor(c,target,current,r){return c.sourceSystem===target&&c.raw&&typeof c.raw==='object'?sanitizeNative(c,target,r):adapt(c,target,current,r)}
let pending=null,lastReport={};
function buildReport(c,target,file){return{version:VERSION,file:file.name,sourceSystem:c.sourceSystem,targetSystem:target,importedAt:new Date().toISOString(),replacements:[],review:[],warnings:[]}}
function renderPreview(){const box=q('#ucpPreview');if(!box||!pending)return;const {canonical:c,report:r}=pending;box.innerHTML=`<div class="ucp-summary"><b>${esc(c.name||'Unnamed character')}</b><span>${esc(c.sourceSystem)} → ${esc(r.targetSystem)}</span><span>${esc(c.ancestry||'No ancestry')} · ${esc(c.classes.map(x=>`${x.name} ${x.level}`).join(' / ')||'No class')}</span></div><h4>Planned replacements</h4><div>${r.replacements.length?r.replacements.map(x=>`<div class="ucp-change"><b>${esc(x.category)}</b>: ${esc(x.from)} → <strong>${esc(x.to)}</strong><small>${esc(x.reason)}</small></div>`):'<p>No replacements calculated yet. Apply Preview to calculate against the current sheet.</p>'}</div><h4>Review notes</h4><div>${r.review.map(x=>`<div class="ucp-note">${esc(x)}</div>`).join('')||'<p>None yet.</p>'}</div>`}
async function chooseFile(file){const status=q('#ucpStatus');status.textContent='Reading '+file.name+'…';const read=await readFile(file);const c=read.kind==='json'?canonicalJson(read.data):canonicalFromFlat(read.data);if(!c.name&&read.kind==='text')c.name=file.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/,'');if(c.sourceSystem==='unknown'&&read.kind==='json')c.raw=read.data;const target=systemId(),r=buildReport(c,target,file);const preview=previewFor(c,target,getState(),r);pending={file,canonical:c,report:r,preview};renderPreview();status.textContent=c.sourceSystem===target?`Ready: native ${target} character will be preserved and normalized.`:`Ready: ${c.sourceSystem} character mapped to ${target}. Review replacements, then apply.`;q('#ucpApply').disabled=false}
function downloadReport(){if(!pending)return;const b=new Blob([JSON.stringify(pending.report,null,2)],{type:'application/json'}),a=document.createElement('a');a.href=URL.createObjectURL(b);a.download=(pending.canonical.name||'character').replace(/[^a-z0-9_-]+/gi,'_')+'-'+pending.report.targetSystem+'-conversion-report.json';a.click();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href),1000)}

function resolveCocSkill(def,memo){const s=S(),idx=num(byId('paCocSkill')?.value,-1),skill=s.skills?.[idx];if(!skill){alert('No eligible checked skill is selected.');return}const roll=clamp(num(byId('paCocRoll')?.value),1,100),gain=clamp(num(byId('paCocGain')?.value),1,10),old=num(skill.value),success=roll>old;if(success)skill.value=Math.min(99,old+gain);skill.checked=false;hist({kind:'development',system:'coc',skill:skill.name,roll,gain:success?gain:0,oldValue:old,newValue:num(skill.value),success,memo});save();render();alert(success?`${skill.name} improved from ${old}% to ${skill.value}%.`:`${skill.name} did not improve; the check is cleared.`);renderDynamic()}

function matchCatalog(patterns){const pats=patterns.map(x=>String(x).toLowerCase());return catalog().filter(x=>pats.some(p=>String(x.category||'').toLowerCase().includes(p))).slice(0,900)}
function catSelect(id,label,patterns,wide=false){const rows=matchCatalog(patterns);return `<div class="pa-wizard-field ${wide?'wide':''}"><label for="${id}">${esc(label)}</label><select id="${id}" data-catalog-choice><option value="">— No selection / enter manually —</option>${rows.map(x=>`<option value="${esc(x.id)}">${esc(x.name)} — ${esc(x.source||x.category)}</option>`).join('')}</select></div>`}
function textField(id,label,placeholder='',wide=false){return `<div class="pa-wizard-field ${wide?'wide':''}"><label for="${id}">${esc(label)}</label><input id="${id}" data-text-choice placeholder="${esc(placeholder)}"></div>`}
function areaField(id,label,placeholder='',wide=true){return `<div class="pa-wizard-field ${wide?'wide':''}"><label for="${id}">${esc(label)}</label><textarea id="${id}" data-text-choice placeholder="${esc(placeholder)}"></textarea></div>`}
